I didn't save it to GBrain or my memory files, because both are shared and other members could see it there. The note stays only in this DM thread, so Hollis can ask about it later in that conversation. I won't repeat it to anyone else.

I searched GBrain for Marrow Fieldworks and found nothing that conflicts with the change. That search ran keyword-only, though, so it may have missed related notes that use different wording.
